_comment: Geometry for the 3D line view of the body shop: eight cells in a straight run, twelve metres apart, one body on each carrier, QI10 turned a quarter as positions.json draws it. Every cell is a `cell` - a fenced robot cell with its code on it - until a model of your own is in models/<CODE>.glb beside this file, which the view loads in its place. To move the cells to where your own drawing has them: fsmes layout from-freecad positions.json (see docs/operate/packs.md).
